reviews.title: App is garbage
reviews.text:
Your app is a piece of garbage. It doesn’t work. It works terribly on a computer, and it doesn’t work at all on the iPhone.

It doesn’t make any distinction between websites and sends erroneous updates to your partner at times when I’m not even using a device. That might not be a problem if I had a friend using the app, but this is shameful stuff, so it’s a big problem when my partner is my wife, who is already worried anyway.

It also doesn’t differentiate between websites with adult content and websites with regular content that happen to contain configuration. I can’t describe the level of anger I feel every time I can’t log into my brokerage account simply because it has a password page.

And there is no workaround. It just doesn’t work.

I don’t want my name publicly associated with your product at all, but when I went to your internal suggestions and support page, I was blocked.

You make an absolutely terrible product. I hope this review can, in some small way, prevent people from wasting their money and time on it.
